messages:
Jon Park: Handoff heads-up — I'll be OOO starting now for ~8h. Primary -> Emma Ruiz. Quick summary of open items:
- Active incident INC-2029: KV cache evictions impacting embeddings for Atlas Analytics (high-reuse keys). Pages fired 3x in the last 6h.
- Mitigation applied: scaled worker pool +20% and toggled aggressive KV prefix caching. Latency dropped but error spikes remain (~0.8% during tails).
- Runbook used: /runbooks/kv-evictions, steps 1-3 applied.

incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-2029 — KV cache evictions. Severity: sev2. Pages: 3. Affected customer: Atlas Analytics (realtime-embedding).

Emma Ruiz: Thanks — taking primary. Quick Q: is traffic throttling enabled at routing?

Jon Park: Yes, temporary throttle at routing layer: `max_inflight=40` on redwood-routing-prod. Left a quick revert command if we need to back off: ```kubectl scale deployment routing --replicas=12```

Aisha Khan: I can be secondary for the next 4h. If infra lift is needed, ping me and I can escalate.

Maurice Li: Filed follow-up ticket INF-4123 to track root cause + metric additions: https://jira/repo/INF-4123

Jon Park: Tagged @eng-runtime and @eng-sre on the ticket. Action items in the ticket: 1) increase cache headroom 2) add eviction alerts + dashboards 3) add perf test reproducer. Also scheduled a postmortem: Mon 2026-03-16 17:00 UTC — invite sent to eng-oncall and runtime.

oncall-bot: Handoff recorded: from Jon Park -> Emma Ruiz. Coverage: primary Emma, secondary Aisha, backup Maurice. Handoff duration: 8h.

Emma Ruiz: I'll keep the throttle and monitor traces. I'll page if error rate >1% sustained for 15m. Where are the alert thresholds defined?

Jon Park: Alerts live in /alerts/kv-eviction.yml. Current threshold: error_rate > 0.75% over 5m. Suggest raising to 1% short-term to reduce noise — create a ticket to restore later.

Aisha Khan: Noted. I'll own the 'restore thresholds' action after Emma finishes triage. Runbook pointer: step 4 (eviction diagnostic) is flaky — use this command to capture KV stats: `curl -s http://metrics/prod/kv?detail=1 | jq .evictions`

Maurice Li: Added a smoke test to INF-4123 and opened a PR: https://github.com/redwood/ops/pull/234 (not merged yet).

Emma Ruiz: Confirmed customer impact: Atlas embeddings are seeing occasional 1.5-2s delays and increased retry churn, which raises token costs for them. Account team notified Diego (Atlas SRE).

Jon Park: :thumbsup: Two follow-ups to prioritize: - Add A/B test for the new eviction policy - Add golden embedding prompts to perf suite so we can catch regressions.

ops-prod-deploy-bot: deploy successful for routing 2026-03-13T23:55Z

Emma Ruiz: I'll write a short incident note in #incidents and tag Diego. Will update this thread after a 1h check-in.

Maurice Li: For the retro notes: my root-cause hypothesis is uneven LRU behavior under bursty tails. I'll collect histograms and cache-hit breakdowns and attach to INF-4123.

Aisha Khan: Coverage note: I'm only available 04:00-08:00 UTC tomorrow. If escalation window goes beyond 01:30 UTC please hand over to Maurice. Marked in rota.

Jon Park: Thanks all. Runbook TODO: add explicit step to purge stale KV entries before scaling up. Action items summary (quick):
- INF-4123 (Maurice) — root cause + metrics + perf test.
- INF-4124 (Aisha) — alerts threshold restore + dashboards.
- INF-4125 (Emma) — customer comms and incident note.
- PR #234 (Maurice) — ops changes for safer scaling.

Emma Ruiz: Ack — owning INF-4125 and updating #incidents. I'll also start a 15m cadence check for the next 2h.

oncall-bot: Reminder: postmortem scheduled Mon 2026-03-16 17:00 UTC. Calendar invite: sent.

Jon Park: Handing off now — I'm offline. If urgent, call my mobile (work): +1-555-0102.

Emma Ruiz: Taking over as primary. Handoff complete — will update last status in ~1h unless escalated.
